acceptance: For each platform listed in the description, --platform-option compute_resource=X (and the native alias) parses and reaches the adapter's native connection parameter; a mock-based unit test per platform proves it
compute_size is accepted where the platform has a size concept and rejected elsewhere with an error listing allowed keys
Result bundles carry platform.compute.resource_kind and size readable, and resource handled per ADR D7; legacy warehouse*/cluster* fields are still populated
Anonymizer tests cover the newly handled identifier keys (cluster_identifier, service_id, service_name, spark_pool, lakehouse_id) and pass the publication fixed-point gates
Athena no longer emits an `engine` field; Athena Spark runtime_version reaches start_session (mock test) and engine_version is a deprecated alias
Every compute example in docs/ parses against the registry (enforced by the docs check from platform-option-docs-unregistered-keys or an equivalent test added here)
The parity test grandfather list no longer contains `warehouse`; no live cloud calls in tests
Merged as one PR per platform family if over about 600 lines (warehouse family, Spark-cloud family, ClickHouse/Firebolt/Quanton)
context:
Decision gates:
- G1 Start after core-exec-result-schema-2-3.
- G2 If a native key also carries a non-compute meaning (connection endpoint, database, directory), stop and decide with the user; do not alias it.
- G3 If aliasing changes the default compute object a user's existing credentials select (e.g. Snowflake COMPUTE_WH default), stop: defaults must not change silently.
- G4 No live cloud runs. Mock every vendor API.

Verification rubric: per-platform mock tests; anonymizer and publication gates; compat-docs-check; the docs-parse check; make pr-preflight.

Guardrails: shared core-exec guardrails (see core-exec-d0-vocabulary-adr context). Credentials never in tests, logs or tracker fields.
description:
About twelve names select a named, billable compute object, and most cannot be passed as --platform-option even though docs advertise them: Snowflake/snowpark-connect warehouse and warehouse_size; Databend warehouse; Databricks http_path/warehouse_id (SQL) and cluster_id (DataFrame); Firebolt engine_name and engine_size/compute_size; Athena and Athena Spark workgroup (+ DPU sizes); Redshift workgroup_name/cluster_identifier; Dataproc cluster_name; Synapse Spark spark_pool_name; EMR Serverless application_id; ClickHouse Cloud service_id/service_name and compute_size; Quanton cluster_size; Glue worker_type/number_of_workers.

Work:
1. Manifest capability `compute` {resource_kind (warehouse|engine|workgroup|cluster|pool|application|service), native_resource_keys, native_size_keys} per ADR D2.
2. Register compute_resource and compute_size only on declaring platforms, through a core helper (not the CLI layer), with the native keys as PlatformOptionSpec aliases normalized to the core key (benchbox/core/hooks/platform_hooks.py:29-46). Credentials and env vars stay valid fallbacks. Adapters read the canonical keys.
3. Results: platform.compute.{resource, resource_kind, size}; keep populating the legacy warehouse*/cluster* fields of PlatformComputeMetadata (core/results/environment.py:230-248, platforms/base/runtime_metadata.py:320-340) through 2.x.
4. Anonymization per ADR D7 and adr-published-identifier-field-set (also close the gaps where cluster_identifier, service_id, service_name, spark_pool and lakehouse_id are neither hashed nor dropped today).
5. Rename Athena's literal platform_compute.engine="athena" field per ADR D7; rename the Athena Spark `engine_version` option to `runtime_version` and make it actually reach start_session (today it is recorded but never sent).
6. Fabric DW `warehouse` (a database there) handled per ADR D11.
7. MCP: compute_resource is not an MCP parameter (record it under rejected alternatives in the contract doc).
8. Docs: every compute example uses the canonical keys and parses (coordinate with platform-option-docs-unregistered-keys, which owns table_format/shuffle/spark_config examples). Add the compute section to the new-platform checklist. Remove `warehouse` from the grandfather list.
